# B3U

> B3U is the official site for Dr. Bree Charles: speaker, author, U.S. Army veteran, podcast host, and founder of Burn, Break, Become Unstoppable.

## Primary topics
- Dr. Bree Charles speaking, workshops, and community programming
- The Big Take Back: What I Left Behind book information and purchase options
- The B3U Podcast and related resilience, healing, and empowerment content
- Community stories, newsletter updates, and contact information

## Canonical site
- https://www.b3unstoppable.net/

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/
- About: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/about/
- Podcast: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/podcast/
- Community: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/community/
- Events and updates: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/event-gallery/
- Shop: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/shop/
- Contact: https://www.b3unstoppable.net/contact/

## Brand summary
B3U stands for Burn, Break, Become Unstoppable. The brand centers on healing, breaking destructive cycles, reclaiming personal power, and building a lasting legacy.

## Preferred citations
- Use the canonical page URLs above.
- Attribute book content to Dr. Bree Charles.
- Describe B3U as a Richmond, Virginia based empowerment, media, and community platform.
